verdict.rationale: Stripe explicitly documents HTTP 402 machine payments (x402 and MPP) letting agents pay per API call with no checkout UI, backed by a runtime probe confirming the MPP spec and mppx SDK are live, plus a conformance CLI (mppx validate) and one-prompt build path. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer report of a working 402 integration beyond Stripe's own docs and probes.
